Finn, a cyber-security specialist, spends his days guarding the company from hacks while secretly feeding his own fetish. Surrounded by screens and cameras, he can’t help but watch every angle, every move of his gorgeous wife, Luna. Playful, loving, sporty, sweet, and sexy… sometimes too naive for her own good.   • Interactive voyeur mode: Watch your wife through surveillance feeds and play minigames to unlock new cameras.

  • Original soundtrack & immersive sound design: Feel every moment, every breath, every secret.
